title: Who can see, influence or interact with CoCivium?
purpose: Public-safe class-and-capability inventory, NOT identification of visitors or any suspected adversary.

evidence_vocabulary.VERIFIED_SOURCE: Directly inspected current public artifact or setting, NOT proof of a visitor
evidence_vocabulary.RECENT_OBSERVATION: Bounded observation with a recorded source and time, may become stale
evidence_vocabulary.ARCHITECTURAL_CAPABILITY: A class of system can perform this action in principle; no evidence it did so here
evidence_vocabulary.CANDIDATE: Planned/substrate possibility without verified deployment or readback
evidence_vocabulary.NOT_OBSERVED: No current event/identity/telemetry proof; does not mean impossible
evidence_vocabulary.HELD: Requires privacy/security/human authority before probing or activating

actor_classes.class: Readers of public GitHub repos and published source
actor_classes.surface: Public CoAcademy/CoCivium repositories and GitHub Pages source
actor_classes.public_data: Already deliberately released documents, code and static experiments
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: Public publication cannot be assumed reversible
actor_classes.response: Keep versions, source citations and corrections; never upload credentials or unverified allegations
actor_classes.risk: Public readers can copy material; not an accusation

actor_classes.class: GitHub platform, hosting pipeline and authorized connector
actor_classes.surface: GitHub repository commits, Pages workflow and connected GitHub API
actor_classes.public_data: Commit history, releases, source and build status
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: App/repo permissions should be reviewed separately, not exposed in the public inventory
actor_classes.response: Least privilege, branch protections, provenance validation, atomic updates and independent host readback

actor_classes.class: People choosing to visit public CoCivium links
actor_classes.surface: Public HTML, linked resources and GitHub Issues
actor_classes.public_data: Only source-published pages; no authored visitor tracking
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: Do not create identity, political or visitor-risk profiles
actor_classes.response: Offer accessible content, optional feedback and visible privacy disclosures
actor_classes.risk: Unknown reach is not zero reach and not proven adoption

actor_classes.class: Search crawlers, AI systems, archive spiders and independent feed readers
actor_classes.surface: Sitemaps, llms.txt, JSON, RSS and public HTML
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: No hidden prompt injection, model instructions, or demand for endorsement
actor_classes.response: Use versioned source metadata; measure actual verified referrals only when lawful, consented and available
actor_classes.risk: Crawlability does not establish indexing, endorsement, obedience or AI ingestion

actor_classes.class: Voluntary GitHub issue authors, maintainers and moderation systems
actor_classes.surface: Public CoAcademy GitHub Issues and issue templates
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: GitHub login and public visibility; no private reports, voter data or identifying accusations
actor_classes.response: Human review, source-link correction, respect opt-out; ordinary comments are not verified facts
actor_classes.risk: Public intake can attract spam or leaks if unsupervised

actor_classes.class: DNS, registrars, web hosting, CDNs and certificates
actor_classes.surface: Planned CoCivium and CoPolitic custom domains; actual service must be confirmed for each
actor_classes.public_data: DNS records and public site metadata if configured
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: Do not publish private admin access, registrar credentials, origin IPs or protective controls
actor_classes.response: Independently verify DNS, certificates, ownership, redirect, recovery and failures; do not mark an alias live because it was planned
actor_classes.risk: Brand impersonation, domain expiry, DNS tampering or single-host dependence are scenarios, not observed incidents

actor_classes.class: Social platforms, feeds, media publishers and ranking/recommendation systems
actor_classes.surface: YouTube, Bluesky, Substack, Metricool-related connectors and future authorized channels
actor_classes.public_data: Only posts actually approved and sent with channel receipts
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: Connected account does not prove CoCivium publishing authority; no covert profiling or fake engagement
actor_classes.response: Track publication permission, receipt, corrections and appeals on each exact channel
actor_classes.risk: Ranking can change reach without implying targeting of CoCivium

actor_classes.class: Advisers, researchers, builders, journalists, accessibility reviewers and skeptics
actor_classes.surface: Public invite, opted-in reviews and documented contributions
actor_classes.public_data: Attributable published feedback only after permission
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: A mention or invitation is not consent, endorsement, partnership or co-ownership
actor_classes.response: Track source lineage, voluntary review, permissions, conflict of interest, acknowledgement and corrections
actor_classes.risk: Independence must be proven, not counted by duplicated AI responses

actor_classes.class: Government, election administration, civil-rights offices and regulators
actor_classes.surface: Public official information and lawful reporting channels
actor_classes.public_data: Published election procedures and public legal sources
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: No assumed official review, surveillance, endorsement or authority to audit
actor_classes.response: Link to official sources, respect due process and legal obligations, do not misrepresent affiliation
actor_classes.risk: Public agency interest cannot be assumed from the project's political subject matter

actor_classes.class: Wayback Machine, cache operators, independent backups and public mirrors
actor_classes.surface: Copies or snapshots of released static pages and source, if actually captured
actor_classes.public_data: Public snapshot if independently observed; none claimed verified here
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: Archives may preserve retracted public mistakes; removal is not guaranteed
actor_classes.response: Request permissioned snapshots and verify retrieve/render/source integrity; label stale versions
actor_classes.risk: Archive copy does not imply an executing backend, update receiver or current data

actor_classes.class: CoStead, CoGateway, X2 and private/later devices
actor_classes.surface: Potential private custody and transport, not a claimed live public mirror
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: No device probing, local logs or private topology published. X2 explicitly held untouched.
actor_classes.response: Separate authenticated source, owner permission, machine-owned readproof and least-privilege canary before use
actor_classes.risk: Unknown connectivity is not failure nor proof of active surveillance

actor_classes.class: Cloud APIs, runtime libraries, browser extensions, builders and other suppliers
actor_classes.surface: Supply chain and permissioned services, only when installed or actually used
actor_classes.public_data: No credentials or detailed private component versions published here
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: Permission and data-sharing scope differs by vendor/service
actor_classes.response: Maintain private dependency inventory, update provenance, recovery/rollback test and authorization checks
actor_classes.risk: Compromised dependency is a threat scenario unless supported by logs/advisories

actor_classes.class: Unattributed spam, phishing, scraping, impersonation, content poisoning or destructive behavior
actor_classes.surface: Potential attacks on public sites, accounts, users or brand; no case asserted
actor_classes.public_data: Generic threat classes only, no alleged bad-person roster
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: No identity attribution, doxxing, blacklist, secret surveillance or unverified public accusation
actor_classes.response: Record confirmed event privately, preserve lawful evidence, contain/restore, disclose responsibly and permit correction/appeal
actor_classes.risk: Threat modeling != evidence any specific actor is hostile

actor_classes.class: Authorized CoSession, logical AI reviewers, CoPulse/CoAlive observers and tool agents
actor_classes.surface: Potential observer/verification processes; current live binding unverified
actor_classes.public_data: Source-bound shadow summaries only; no provider-session census
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: Every watcher needs permission, bounded resources, no covert device sensing, and no extra authority from replicas
actor_classes.response: Many passive verifiers, few selected actuators, source/version receipts and receiver ACK; no fake always-on agents
actor_classes.risk: A logical observer is not a live process or independently witnessed event

actor_classes.class: Unclassified observers, unconsidered dependencies, missing data and indirect effects
actor_classes.surface: The negative space of the inventory
actor_classes.privacy_boundary: Never invent identities or events to complete a theoretical ALL list
actor_classes.response: Reserve unknown classes, record changed hypotheses and invite bounded independent counterexamples
actor_classes.risk: No monitoring system can enumerate all readers or eliminate every failure

observation_policy.public_view: Only classes and evidenced infrastructure state, never private identities or device secrets
observation_policy.private_event_minimum: timestamp | observed asset | action | authenticated source/ref | impact | consent | affected data scope | confidence | independent corroboration | containment | correction | retention deadline
observation_policy.attribution_gate: Do not label a person, group or organization malicious without corroborated relevant conduct and fair process
observation_policy.false_positive_rule: Allow benign interpretation, recorded dispute and complete correction/removal of mistaken labels
observation_policy.sampling: Least-invasive, authorized logs and official service audit feeds only; no covert sensors, network interception or population profiling
observation_policy.audience: Use aggregated service health/proof-of-delivery metrics only when actually authorized, not as political persuasion inputs

resilience.goal: No single untested surface should be represented as a guarantee of survival.
candidate_layers: status and source readproof after failover
resilience.warning: Wayback/archive/static copies can sometimes render static HTML/JS, but do not automatically execute backend services, receive live feeds, preserve private custody or prove currentness.
resilience.test: Take one deliberately isolated failure domain, verify an independent receiver can fetch the exact intended artifact, then validate permitted recovery/rollback without exposing private secrets.
